## History

Rogerson was a middle-aged lady who taught a Sunday school class for twenty years. During her service, she instructed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when the girl attended church alone. Following the service, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounted her impressions of Rogerson and the Sunday school experience to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
